---
title: "Module: `EOSSDK_Ecom` (entitlements / offers / store)"
---

Tier A. **Local-only** (no network listener): fakes ownership/entitlements from config. 31 methods.

## Handle & shape
`EOS_HEcom` via `EOS_Platform_GetEcomInterface`. `IRunCallback` only. `EmuDeinit` @`0x1800c3860` (no separate EmuInit shown — minimal init).

## Behavior
Emulates the Epic store as **fully owned/unlocked** driven by `Settings.unlock_dlcs`. Async queries complete immediately with a synthesized result (standard FrameResult, 100 ms), then sync `Copy*`/`Get*Count` read the cached synthesized catalog.

## API
- **Ownership (async):** `QueryOwnership` @`0x1800bde80` (fakes owned per `unlock_dlcs`), `QueryOwnershipBySandboxIds` @`0x1800bf540` (NEW), `QueryOwnershipToken` @`0x1800be7f0`.
- **Entitlements (async):** `QueryEntitlements` @`0x1800beaf0`, `QueryEntitlementToken` @`0x1800bffa0`, `RedeemEntitlements` @`0x1800c0960`.
- **Offers/Checkout (async):** `QueryOffers` @`0x1800c03c0`, `Checkout` @`0x1800c0610`.
- **Sync copies:** entitlements (`CopyEntitlementById/ByIndex/ByNameAndIndex`, `GetEntitlementsCount`/`ByNameCount`, `GetLastRedeemedEntitlements*`), offers (`CopyOfferById/ByIndex`, `CopyOfferItem/ImageInfo`, counts), items (`CopyItemById`, `CopyItemImageInfo/Release`, counts), transactions (`CopyTransactionById/ByIndex`, count).

## Reimpl notes
- Reimpl: a config-driven catalog; report everything owned when `unlock_dlcs`; entitlements enumerable; Checkout/Redeem succeed no-op. Callback-infos `EOS_Ecom_*CallbackInfo`.
- Follow-up: where the fake catalog comes from (static vs config file items); `QueryEntitlementToken`/`QueryOwnershipToken` token format.
